changelog:
Initial release: AI-powered date and meeting spot recommendation using Amap POI search and intelligent filtering.

- Automatically locates a central, convenient meeting spot based on user input of one or two locations.
- Recommends 3 distinct venues suitable for conversation, with detailed rationale, itinerary, photo tips, parking info, and alternatives.
- Filters out noisy or unsuitable places; dynamically adjusts search based on scenario, time, weather, preferences, special occasions, and transportation.
- Supports nuanced requests for dating, friendship meetups, business chats, anniversaries, and more.
- Integrates Amap for POI, route, and weather data; adapts recommendations based on open hours and photo-worthiness.
